# Georgetown Heating & Cooling

> Georgetown Heating & Cooling provides heating and cooling service to homeowners in and around Georgetown, Wellington County, Ontario. The team handles furnace and AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump service, gas fireplace work, thermostat upgrades, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (905) 877-5208  |  Email: contact@georgetownheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://georgetownheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Georgetown, Guelph, Milton, Fergus, Elora, Acton, Rockwood
